theorem.title: Failure of the 2-degenerate bound
theorem.normalized_statement: There exist a fixed connected bipartite 2-degenerate graph H and constants c, epsilon > 0 such that ex(n,H) >= c*n^(3/2+epsilon) for all sufficiently large n.
